scientific_scope_status: The acquired P1 proofs construct a global conditional frequency bracket with success at least 1-alpha and total interrogation O(log(1/alpha)/epsilon), at fixed finite correction strength as precision improves. A finite three-qubit supplier certifies positive null exposure from warm correlated states, including bounded transverse coherent persistent memory and a nonzero upward reset rate. The estimator does not reset the hidden environment or divide by an unlearned gain.
